newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX'S HOEKSTRA TO HAVE KNEE OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX'S HOEKSTRA TO HAVE KNEE OPERATION.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam's international winger Peter Hoekstra will have a knee operation next week that will keep him out of action for most of the rest of the season, Dutch media said on Friday.
Hoekstra, bought last season as a stand-in for the injured Marc Overmars, has hardly played since damaging his left knee during the European championship in England in June.
On Thursday, Ajax captain Danny Blind announced he was to have a groin operation on Friday and would miss up to three months of the season.
Struggling in the domestic league and faring no better in Europe, Ajax have several key players sidelined by long-term problems and several others recovering from injuries. REUTER
